name: Feedback Hub
description: Microsoft tool for sending problem reports, product suggestions, and system diagnostics to Windows engineering teams.

name: Get Help
description: Built-in support client that runs guided troubleshooters, searches help articles, and connects to Microsoft customer support.

name: Outlook for Windows
description: Web-based desktop mail client for reading email, managing calendars, and storing contacts.

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Chat and video meeting client for group messaging, voice calls, and online screen sharing.

name: Clipchamp
description: Timeline video editor for trimming clips, recording camera or screen footage, and exporting video files.

name: Microsoft 365
description: Start portal for opening Office web apps, viewing OneDrive files, and managing a Microsoft 365 subscription.

name: Media Player
description: Default Windows application for playing local music and video files, browsing media libraries, and managing playlists.

name: Bing Search
description: System package that connects Windows Search and the Start menu to online Bing web results.

name: Quick Assist
description: Remote assistance utility that lets another person view or control the PC over the internet using a session code.

name: Dev Home
description: Control center for software developers to monitor system resources, clone repositories, and configure coding environments.

name: Mobile Devices
description: Background component that links Windows Settings with paired phones and tablets. Removing it stops phone camera streaming, file sharing, and hotspot linking.

name: To Do
description: Task manager for organizing checklists, setting due dates, and syncing reminders with a Microsoft account.

name: Power Automate
description: Workflow tool for building and running automated desktop sequences across local apps and web pages.

name: Phone Link
description: Companion app that connects an Android phone or iPhone to the PC for reading messages, viewing photos, and placing calls.

name: Sticky Notes
description: Note-taking utility that keeps small text and ink memos pinned on the screen and synced to the cloud.

name: Sound Recorder
description: Audio recording utility for capturing voice memos from a microphone and saving them to local audio files.

name: Clock
description: Timekeeping utility with alarms, countdown timers, a stopwatch, world time zones, and focus timers.

name: Paint
description: Raster graphics editor for drawing shapes, painting freehand lines, cropping pictures, and saving common image formats.

name: Notepad
description: Plain-text editor with tabbed windows for reading and editing unformatted documents, logs, and scripts.

name: Snipping Tool
description: Screen capture utility for taking rectangular or full-screen snapshots, recording desktop video, and annotating images.

name: Copilot
description: Desktop client for Microsoft's cloud chat assistant to answer questions, draft text, and generate images.

name: Calculator
description: Desktop calculator with modes for basic math, scientific functions, base conversions, and measurement units.

name: Camera
description: Webcam application for taking still pictures, scanning barcodes, and recording video from built-in or USB cameras.

name: Photos
description: Image viewer and gallery organizer for browsing picture folders, rotating or resizing photos, and viewing OneDrive albums.

name: News
description: Reader app that fetches news stories, topical feeds, and publisher articles from the Microsoft Start network.

name: Weather
description: Forecast app showing current temperatures, hourly precipitation charts, severe weather alerts, and radar maps.

name: Xbox App
description: Storefront and launcher for installing PC Game Pass titles, browsing the Xbox catalog, and chatting with Xbox friends.

name: Xbox Game Bar
description: In-game screen overlay opened with Win+G for recording gameplay clips, adjusting per-app volume, and viewing hardware stats.

name: Xbox Identity Provider
description: Background sign-in service that connects PC games and Microsoft Store titles to an Xbox Live account.
warning: removing this may break Microsoft account sign-in for non-Xbox games and apps that rely on this authentication pipeline.

name: Xbox Speech To Text Overlay
description: Accessibility component that transcribes in-game party voice chat into on-screen text and reads typed chat aloud.

name: Xbox TCUI
description: Callable user interface library that displays Xbox Live sign-in prompts, friend pickers, and profile cards inside games.
warning: removing this may break Microsoft account authentication in games and apps that do not otherwise require the Xbox app.

name: Start Experiences App
description: Content provider that supplies MSN news, weather, and stock cards to the Windows Widgets board.

name: Solitaire Collection
description: Card game pack containing Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, and TriPeaks with Xbox achievement support.

name: Movies & TV
description: Video playback app for watching local movie files and streaming films or shows bought from the Microsoft Store.
